labnex.description: A modern open source Android client for GitLab that lets you manage projects, issues, merge requests, commits, and more directly from your phone. LabNex supports both GitLab.com and self-hosted GitLab instances, with features like multiple account support, biometric lock, markdown editing, code diff viewing, and a clean Material You inspired interface. It’s privacy-friendly, actively maintained, and built for developers who want a full GitLab experience on Android.
